note: Confirmed — autumn 1957 Turkey deployed ~50,000 troops on Syrian border; US deployed Mediterranean fleet; crisis defused by diplomacy; year and details match

note: Confirmed — post-secession Syrian government reversed unpopular UAR economic measures; returned some nationalized properties; pleased business but angered leftists; year matches

note: Confirmed — Ba'athist government nationalized banks, large industries, foreign enterprises; accelerated land reform; triggered capital flight; year matches
